derived.description: Build the battle with 5 Pokémon in 5 different Poké Balls! Build, train and battle with 5 iconic Pokémon figures in this exclusive Poké Ball Pack. In every battle, a Pokémon trainer must choose wisely. Now, discover 5 Pokémon to build and battle with in this multi-figure pack! This pack features some of the most popular Pokémon, including Cubone, Zubat, Caterpie, Magikarp and, of course, Pikachu! And each figure comes with a different type of Poké Ball with a pronged top and interior so you can display your Pokémon! Ideal for ages 6 and up.
derived.title: MEGA Pokémon Action Figures Building Toys, Poké Ball Pack with Pikachu, Magikarp, Cubone, Zubat, Magikarp and 5 Different Poké Balls (Amazon Exclusive)
